name: Farstone meets then beats Kerbal Space Program: fly through an atmosphere: drag, lift, Isp lowered by pressure, heating
asks:
I want us to start working toward Farstone having a full-on game like Kerbal Space Program in it, but obviously, we want to beat Kerbal Space Program using everything the world has learned between when it was designed and now, and critically, use our own math as much as we can to help us. [...] the goal you should aim toward is beating Kerbal Space Program with Farstone (I'm picturing orbital launch platforms being one kind of ship that folk can build)

---

we've planned elsewhere trying to meet-then-beat Kerbal Space Program with our game engines, and then including in Farstone, our falgship MMORPG, a KSP-like game for folk (which is also part of how we justify our weird little MMORPG growing sci-fi wings)

Marked for conversion to signed SignCell predication cells (four-valued charge) when the orchestrator's canonical call arrives.

ledger.job: Fly through an atmosphere: drag, lift, Isp lowered by pressure, heating.

incumbent.statement: However, an atmosphere makes taking off from a planet more difficult (by producing aerodynamic drag and lowering engine Isp) and increases the minimum stable orbit altitude.

ledger.reason: Drag on ascent, re-entry, aerobraking and KSP's minimum stable orbit are met; Isp does not fall with pressure, and there is no lift, heating or parachute.
ledger.next: Isp by pressure, parachutes and landing, heating as diffusion over the part graph (F17).
